context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren plan a spin-off venture.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; competition vocabulary (コスト/競争/独立/設計/つて) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この部門を、独立させたいと思う。
lines.en: I'm thinking of spinning off this division.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 独立すれば、競争にも強くなりますね。
lines.en: Once independent, it'll be stronger in competition.
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コストの設計は、できているかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事業の設計を、見直しているところです。
lines.en: I'm reviewing the business design now.
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取引先は、つてで広げられるかね?
lines.en: Can we expand clients through connections?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: つてを活かしつつ、新規も開拓します。
lines.en: We'll use connections while opening new accounts.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コストを抑え、競争に勝とう。
lines.en: Let's cut costs and win the competition.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm composed clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 独立に向けて、設計を固めます。
lines.en: Toward independence, I'll firm up the design.
lines.style: resolved young manager voice, soft warm closing throughout
